evals.prompt: I'm building a .NET 10 Blazor WASM app using BlazorCN. Create a settings form component (.razor) with fields for: full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push as independent on/off toggles). Bind the values and show a required-field message for the name.
evals.expected_output: A Razor component using FieldGroupCn/FieldCn for layout, SwitchCn for the independent toggles, @bind-Value on inputs, gap-* spacing, and semantic color tokens.
expectations: Uses FieldCn (and FieldGroupCn) for form layout instead of raw div with space-y-*
Uses SwitchCn for independent on/off notification toggles (not a loop of ButtonCn with manual active state)
Binds inputs with @bind-Value and uses the correct value types
Uses FieldDescriptionCn or FieldErrorCn for the helper/validation message rather than a custom styled span
Uses gap-* (flex flex-col gap-*) instead of space-y-* / space-x-*
Uses semantic color tokens (text-muted-foreground, text-destructive, bg-background) instead of raw colors like text-red-500
No manual dark: color overrides
Every component name ends in Cn and the file uses @using BlazorCN

evals.prompt: Create a Blazor dialog (.razor) for editing a user profile using BlazorCN. It should show the user's avatar at the top, inputs for name and bio, and Save/Cancel buttons (Save with a check icon, Cancel with an X icon). Open the dialog from a button.
evals.expected_output: A Razor component with DialogCn (@bind-Open or trigger), a DialogTitleCn for accessibility, AvatarCn + AvatarFallbackCn, Lucide icon components nested directly inside ButtonCn (no sizing classes, no data-icon).
expectations: Includes DialogTitleCn inside DialogHeaderCn for accessibility
Opens the dialog via DialogTriggerCn or @bind-Open (not a hand-rolled show/hide div)
AvatarCn includes AvatarFallbackCn alongside AvatarImageCn
Icons are concrete Lucide{Name}Cn components nested inside ButtonCn content (e.g. <LucideCheckCn />), with NO size-* classes on them and NO data-icon attribute
Uses ButtonCn Variant for Cancel (e.g. ButtonVariant.Outline) instead of overriding colors via Class
Every component name ends in Cn

evals.prompt: Create a Blazor dashboard component (.razor) using BlazorCN that shows 4 stat cards in a responsive grid. Each card has a title, a large number, a percentage-change badge, and a loading skeleton state.
evals.expected_output: A Razor component with full Card composition (CardHeaderCn/CardTitleCn/CardContentCn), SkeletonCn for loading, BadgeCn for the change, semantic colors, and gap-* spacing.
expectations: Uses full Card composition (CardCn + CardHeaderCn + CardTitleCn + CardContentCn) instead of dumping everything into CardContentCn
Uses SkeletonCn for loading placeholders instead of a custom animate-pulse div
Uses BadgeCn (with a Variant) for the percentage change instead of a custom styled span
Uses semantic color tokens instead of raw colors like bg-green-500 / text-red-600
Uses gap-* for grid/stack spacing instead of space-y-* / space-x-*
Uses size-* when width and height are equal instead of separate w-* h-*
